---
applyTo: "src/i18n/**/*.ts"
---

# i18n Instructions

## File Structure

```text
src/i18n/
├── config.ts          # Locale list, BCP 47 tags, defaultLocale — edit to add a new locale
├── utils.ts           # getLangFromUrl, useTranslations, useTranslatedPath, formatDate, formatNumber, pluralize
├── index.ts           # Barrel re-export
└── translations/
    ├── index.ts       # Merges common + tools per locale
    ├── en/
    │   ├── common.ts  # Navigation, layout, ARIA labels, shared UI strings
    │   └── tools.ts   # Tool-specific strings
    └── es/
        ├── common.ts  # Spanish equivalents — must mirror en/common.ts structure
        └── tools.ts   # Spanish equivalents — must mirror en/tools.ts structure
```

## Key Naming Convention

Dot-notation with a section prefix:

```text
nav.*              Navigation items
ui.*               Generic UI labels (buttons, states, messages)
aria.*             ARIA labels for screen readers
content.*          Content-level notices (fallback, draft, etc.)
tools.*            Tool-specific strings (tools.ts only)
tools.shared.*     Shared tool strings (copy, copied, error, etc.)
```

## Rules

- **English is the source of truth** — add keys to `en/` first, then `es/`
- **Both locales updated together** — never add a key to one file without the other
- **No hardcoded English strings** in component templates or ARIA labels — always use `t()`
- **Blog post body content** stays in English — only UI chrome is translated
- **`t()` falls back to EN** if a key is missing in ES — use as a safety net, not a workflow
- **Interpolation syntax**: `{param}` in the string, `t("key", { param: value })` at call site

## Adding a Key

```typescript
// 1. src/i18n/translations/en/common.ts
ui: {
  share: "Share",
}

// 2. src/i18n/translations/es/common.ts
ui: {
  share: "Compartir",
}

// 3. Use in a component
const t = useTranslations(locale);
// ...
<button>{t("ui.share")}</button>
```

## Injecting Translations into `<script is:inline>`

Scripts cannot import modules. Pass translations via `data-*` attributes:

```astro
---
const t = useTranslations(locale);
---

<div
  data-error-msg={t("ui.error")}
  data-copy-label={t("tools.shared.copy")}
>
  <!-- content -->
</div>

<script is:inline nonce="NGINX_CSP_NONCE">
  const container = document.querySelector("[data-error-msg]");
  const errorMsg = container.getAttribute("data-error-msg");
</script>
```

## Testing

```bash
pnpm test:e2e tests/i18n.spec.ts
```
